text:
jordan: quick heads-up — cust_acme reports embeddings suddenly coming back as 2048 instead of 1536 after yesterday's model rollout. app throws a shape error.

jordan: sample error from their service: `{'error':'embedding dimension mismatch','details':'expected 1536, got 2048','model':'openembed-1536@v1','request_id':'02f4c'}`

sara: which customer? request_id?

jordan: cust_acme, req 02f4c. sample curl they used:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxx' 
  -d '{"model":"openembed-1536","input":"hello world"}'
```

maria: :eyes: Was this right after we enabled variant fallback for capacity spikes? Could be routing returning a 2048 variant under the same alias.

dave: oncall — I'm pulling router logs now.

ops-bot: alert: embedding-dim-anomaly detected for cust_acme (score 0.87) — created incident #INC-4392

dave: found entries — router selected `openembed-2048` for several requests from cust_acme around 11:02 UTC due to capacity fallback. policy allowed alias fallback to any compatible variant, but obviously dims differ.

sara: that explains it. if the client code assumes 1536 vectors it'll blow up. immediate mitigations: 1) force explicit model id in gateway for that tenant, 2) reject mismatched dims at gateway with a helpful 4xx, 3) offer an automated pad/trim shim (not ideal).

jordan: customer asking for fastest safe fix. they don't want silent trimming.

maria: fastest non-invasive fix is to disable alias fallback for cust_acme at routing layer (deny substitution). I'll prep a rule.

dave: done — disabled alias fallback for cust_acme at 11:10 UTC. deploy-bot shows config pushed.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: route-config update applied by dave at 2025-03-12T11:11:05Z

jordan: they re-tested and now get 1536 vectors again. customer relieved but wants list of requests that got 2048 so they can reprocess.

sara: I'll run a query against embeddings_logs to list affected requests in the 11:00-11:12 window. example query: `SELECT request_id FROM embeddings_logs WHERE customer='cust_acme' AND vector_len!=1536 AND ts >= 1700000000 AND ts <= 1700000800`

maria: action items: (a) add dimension metadata to model aliases so fallback checks dims, (b) change default gateway behavior to return 4xx on dim mismatch, (c) postmortem on catalog change that allowed alias to point at multi-dim family.

dave: filing follow-up CLs and will escalate to eng-ml to stop alias drift.

jordan: customer asked for ETA on postmortem. I told them we'll provide a short summary by EOD and a timeline for catalog hardening. :thumbsup:

sara: I'll generate the list of affected request_ids and share in private thread within 30m.

maria: adding a note to the model-onboarding checklist: assert `embedding_dim` required field.

jordan: thanks team — quick and clean. closing the immediate escalation; keeping this thread for the follow-up work.
